endorsements.name: Walter C. Daugherity
endorsements.label: Quantum Computing 101: How to Crack RSA
endorsements.description: The brand-new technology of quantum computers offers the prospect of exponential speedup, making heretofore infeasible problems like cracking RSA conceiveable. The fundamentals of quantum computing are presented, and how a quantum computer could be used to crack RSA is described.
